name: Kukul Kanan
source:
An Elven Lancer who protects the Forest Kingdom of Diahelm. She loves the forest she calls home, and considers fighting for her comrades there a matter of pride. She views Energeia and its research with hostility, but in reality she is a very curious and kindhearted soul. She treats her younger brother Elmin with love and care, and it is clear that she treasures him dearly.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
